question: Compare Ardmere River Station dispatch-record retention with Larchfen Seed Depot accession-record retention, including both exceptions.
answer:
[1] Ardmere River Station dispatch records are retained for 16 months, unless an unresolved flood review requires longer retention.

[2] Larchfen Seed Depot accession records are retained for 5 years, unless an unresolved quarantine case requires longer retention.
